# met by

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:metBy`](gmeow-metBy.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/metBy>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)

Allen MET-BY: this event begins exactly when the related event ends; inverse of [`gmeow:meets`](gmeow-meets.md). (= [time:intervalMetBy](http://www.w3.org/2006/time#intervalMetBy); TimeML IAFTER; TEO [`metBy`](gmeow-metBy.md).)
